mechanics.stacking: Royal only; one layer per positive hit; keyword-only legacy cards count as one. Recruitment stacks persist; battle additions do not.
mechanics.buffs: One event per positive stat application per recipient, temporary combat included, zero/negative-only/triple/base summon excluded, ledger settlement excluded.
mechanics.migration: Old saves start with zero buff history; existing stats and shield keyword retained.

benchmark.method: 16 routes with a fixed base hero for each tribe, normal AI recruitment, rotating round-robin fights for 16 rounds. No PvP damage/elimination; actual self-harm/healing and combat resources/permanent growth persist. Neutral probes are separate copies with seven equal-body minions, two shields and two guards. Not a live-game win-rate claim.

verification.browser: drag stacking, layer animation, count preview, save reload, normal/golden catalog, 360/390 px layouts, blocked layer popup, offline assets
